Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands over his patient, Jack, who sits on a hospital bed, staring blankly into space 🤯. Dr. Smith holds out a small glass of medication, his voice firm but controlled 💊.

DR. SMITH:
"Jack, it's time for your medication. Please take it, it's for your own good 🤝."

JACK:
"I don't want it. I don't need it. I'm fine 🙅‍♂️."

DR. SMITH:
"Jack, you're not fine. You're sick, and this medication will help you get better 💪."

JACK:
"I don't believe you. You're just trying to control me 🚫."

DR. SMITH:
"Fine, if you won't take it, I'll take it for you myself 💊."

Dr. Smith forces the pills into Jack's mouth, and Jack spits them out in disgust 🤢.

DR. SMITH:
"Good, now let's try this again 💊."

Dr. Smith takes the pills himself, and as he swallows, the room begins to distort and blur 🌌.

CUT TO:

INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - LATER 🕰️

Dr. Smith sits in his office, staring blankly at a file on his desk 📁. Suddenly, he looks up to see Jack standing in front of him, a mischievous grin spreading across his face 😏.

JACK:
"Hey, Doc. I see you're taking your meds 🤣."

DR. SMITH:
"Who...what are you talking about? 🤔"

JACK:
"You're the one who's been pretending to be sane all along 🤯."

Dr. Smith's eyes widen in shock as he realizes the truth: he's the one who's been delusional, not Jack 🤦‍♂️.

CUT TO:

EXT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🌞

Dr. Smith sits on a bench outside the asylum, staring at the ground in despair 😔. He looks up to see Jack standing next to him, a knowing smile on his face 😊.

JACK:
"You're welcome, Doc. I'm glad I could help you see the truth 🙏."

Dr. Smith's eyes glaze over, and he whispers:

DR. SMITH:
"I'm not sane. I'm not sane at all 🤯."

FADE TO BLACK 🎥
